profile: LivaNova develops, manufactures, markets, and sells medical products, therapies, and services through its Cardiopulmonary and Neuromodulation segments. Cardiopulmonary offerings include heart-lung machines, oxygenators, autotransfusion systems, tubing systems, cannulae, accessories, and related services for surgical care. Neuromodulation provides devices for vagus nerve stimulation therapy for drug-resistant epilepsy and difficult-to-treat depression, and develops a system for obstructive sleep apnea.
